name: Sebastianskapelle Ladenburg: guided tour
description: 30-minute tour of the former episcopal court chapel with medieval wall paintings
details:
Short tour of the Sebastianskapelle, the former episcopal court chapel of Ladenburg, by the Heimatbund: foundations from the early 11th century, choir and most wall paintings from the second half of the 15th century, altars from the 18th century (currently covered for restoration).

Sunday 14:00-14:30, meeting point at the chapel entrance on the Amtshof. 5 EUR, of which 1 EUR goes to the restoration of the wall paintings. Tours run every second Sunday of the month.
